title: SweatyPanzer
description:
Fast-paced multiplayer tank battlesSweatyPanzer is a free-to-play multiplayer tank game with fast-paced combat, where positioning and strategic decisions matter. Build up a tank over one life in Arena, or work with your team through a round-based Clash match.

Arena: endless free-for-allEvery other tank is an enemy. Each kill repairs your tank and earns a card draw. Choose an upgrade or swap to a different tank without losing your upgrades. Taking down a heavily upgraded opponent earns better cards.

Stay alive to grow your build. Get destroyed and you respawn with your upgrades reset. Dominate the arena and become a bounty for everyone to hunt.

The map changes every six minutes, but surviving tanks keep their health, upgrades and kills.

Clash: round-based 4v4You have one life each round. Destroy the other team, or capture the flag when it becomes active later in the round. First to three round wins takes the match.

Between rounds, buy upgrades that last for the match. Improve your firepower, mobility or protection, equip an ability such as smoke, or switch tanks. A loss pays more than a win, giving the losing team a chance to change its approach.

If your tank is destroyed, the game is not over! You can take a machine gun on top of a teammate's tank turret and keep fighting until the next round. 

13 tanks that play differentlyChoose familiar tanks such as the Panzer IV, T-34, Tiger and Pershing, or try something with a different way of fighting. The Luchs is a dangerous flanker with an autocannon, the AMX-13 carries a six-round revolver, and the IS-2 rewards a well-placed shot with heavy damage and a long reload.

Some tanks offer alternative weapons. The KV-7 chooses between twin 76 mm guns and a single 152 mm, while the StuG can swap its 7.5 cm cannon for a 10.5 cm howitzer. The Sherman offers an entire arsenal: 76 mm cannon, a 105 mm howitzer, the QF 17-pounder and a T105 183 mm rocket launcher.

Where you hit matters as much as what you fire. Rear shots do far more damage than frontal hits, angled armour can ricochet shells, and projectiles have travel time and drop. Use cover to close the distance abd find a flank.

Five battlefields that don't stay the sameFight across desert, farmland, snow, tropical coast and a ruined city. The terrain changes between matches, so the same map does not give you exactly the same hills, dips and sightlines every time.

The battlefield also changes while you fight. Shells dig craters, trees can be knocked down, and walls, hedgerows and other pieces of cover can be shot apart. 

Play alone or with friendsQueue on your own or bring a party of up to four. Bots fill empty places and real players can replace them as they join. They do more than drive toward the nearest enemy: bots share enemy positions, react to flanking attempts, change targets and push together when they have the advantage.

Try tanks in the practice range, or compete on the seasonal ladder from Bronze to Grandmaster. Your current rank is also shown on your tank as gold bands around the barrel.

Free to playPlay for free and expand your roster as you go. Unlock new tanks along the progression road, build mastery with the ones you use most, earn medals and titles, and customize your tanks with accents, charms and other cosmetics.
description_short: Free-to-play tank combat with 13 tanks and two modes, endless free-for-all Arena and round-based 4v4 Clash. Fight across five battlefields with terrain changing every game, and upgrade your tank as the match progresses.
